description: FIX-PLAN Item 33a seam, IN direction. Written by the Skill 44 side at execution into working/ghl/ghl-ops-receipt.json; read and judged by presentations (scripts/ghl_ops.py, judge_receipt). Per-object results WITH verification read-backs. THE RULE: an entry claiming success without its read-back is judged UNVERIFIED, never success. An operation judges verified only when its entry carries the remote object id AND a read-back in which every check the request named for that operation is present with ok true. Runtime judging lives in ghl_ops.judge_receipt; this file is the contract document the executor writes against.

built_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the execution this receipt reports.

execution.description: Provenance of the execution: who ran it, under which access tier, with what durable execution id. A receipt without durable provenance is not evidence.

access_tier_used.description: The Skill 36 tier actually used (for example tier0_caf_pit, tier0_caf_firebase, tier4_managed_browser). Recorded because capabilities differ per tier (workflow export needs the Firebase token tier).

execution_id.description: Durable execution id from the executing side.

executor.description: The executing skill or agent surface (Skill 44 / caf).

skill44_version.description: Skill 44's skill-version.txt value at execution time, when known.

request_id.description: Must echo the request's request_id exactly. A mismatch judges the whole receipt invalid (stale or foreign), and nothing in it is judged.

request_version.description: Must echo the request's request_version. Answering a superseded version judges the receipt invalid (stale).

results.description: One entry per operation in the request, keyed by op_id. A missing entry judges that operation missing, which keeps the receipt from completing.

detail.description: Free-text detail: what happened, or why the operation fell back or failed. Required in spirit for any claim other than success.

readback.description: The verification read-back: one entry per check the request named for this operation, each with ok true or false and what was observed. THE HONESTY CORE OF THE SEAM: a success claim with this block absent or empty judges UNVERIFIED, never success. Forms: object exists in GHL (with its id), attached to the right funnel/page, fields match the contract, embed live on the page. Workflows: exists, trigger bound to the live form id, steps match, draft state recorded. Test submission: the submission landed in the form's submission list, the contact is scoped to the run, the workflow enrollment is observed. Products and order forms: exist, bound, priced exactly as the offer states.

check.description: The check name, echoing the request's expect list for this operation.

object_id.description: For the object_exists check: the live GHL object id observed on read-back. Must equal the entry's remote object id.

observed.description: What the read-back actually observed (counts, states, bound ids, amounts), in words or values. An ok with nothing observed is weak evidence; judges may treat it as such in future versions.

ok.description: Whether this check passed on read-back.

remote.description: The live GHL object this entry claims to have produced or verified.

object_id.description: The live GHL object id (form id, workflow id, product id, calendar id). A success claim without it judges unverified: there is nothing to bind the read-back to.

status_claimed.description: What the EXECUTOR claims (never what presentations concludes; the judge's per-operation verdict is computed from the read-back, not from this claim). created or reused or verified: a success claim, which the read-back must prove. partial: some work landed, stated plainly. failed: the operation did not land; detail says why. skipped: not attempted; a skip is never judged done.

scope.description: Must echo the request's scope. A location_id that differs from the bound location judges the receipt invalid (WRONG_LOCATION).

status.description: The executor's own summary claim (complete, partial, failed, blocked). Advisory only: presentations recomputes the verdict from the per-operation read-backs and never adopts this value.

title: ghl-ops-receipt
